Hey Felix! The design review note for hop_distances was that Depot reports print the mapping as-is, so the iteration order is part of the contract: entries must be ordered by hop count, and then alphabetically by depot code for those with the same count. Hope that helps with ROUTEKIT-105!

Hi Mara! Regarding heaviest_route: the design review agreed that among routes with the same maximum load, we should prioritize the one with the fewest roads. If there's still a tie, use the lexicographically smallest list of depot codes.

I have the notes here: 'The bay controller uses a "smallest ready job first" rule: after every pick, look at all jobs whose prerequisites are now done and take the alphabetically smallest one. This gives the lexicographically smallest valid order; it is not a level-by-level (FIFO queue) order.' Hope this helps!
